applications.name: Identity Data Manager
applications.description: Resolves people and associates source entities, assets and episodes with person records.

applications.name: Entity Allocation Manager
applications.description: Governs source entities and attributes, and manages their allocations to consuming systems.

applications.name: Hierarchy Data Manager
applications.description: Maintains hierarchies and node structures, including mappings to ODM organisational nodes.

applications.name: KPI
applications.description: Provides performance measurement, analytic views and geographic intelligence.

applications.name: Organisational Data Manager
applications.description: Provides organisational nodes and contextual structures used by the wider suite.

applications.name: OneVision
applications.description: Planned user-facing hub presenting outputs from the OneVision suite.

applications.name: OneVision.UI
applications.description: Reusable governed UI design system applied across application interfaces, not a data integration provider.

capabilities.name: Governed entity catalogue
capabilities.summary: Register and retrieve canonical source entities and attributes, preserving source identity and lineage.

capabilities.name: Entity allocation lifecycle
capabilities.summary: Associate known entities with consumer targets, including effective dates, allocation state and multiple-target support according to class rules.

capabilities.name: Bulk allocations
capabilities.summary: Submit multiple allocations efficiently in a single bulk operation.

capabilities.name: Person identity and matching
capabilities.summary: Resolve and match source information to canonical people with confidence and ambiguity handling.

capabilities.name: Episode association
capabilities.summary: Associate episodes and source assets with resolved person records.

capabilities.name: Hierarchy management
capabilities.summary: Build and maintain hierarchical structures, including templated and snapshot-based views.

capabilities.name: Organisational node resolution
capabilities.summary: Resolve hierarchy nodes to directly assigned or inherited ODM organisational context.

capabilities.name: Performance and geographic insight
capabilities.summary: Present governed KPI measures, values and geographical views.

capabilities.name: Unified suite presentation
capabilities.summary: Planned presentation of governed outputs from constituent suite applications.

capabilities.name: Reusable interface patterns
capabilities.summary: Common visual and interaction patterns used by suite applications.

integrations.name: Entity resolution and allocation
integrations.description: IDM uses EAM to resolve known source entities and associate them with its people and competency records, retaining canonical lineage.
integrations.notes: Unknown entity values are not implicitly created. Bulk allocations support automated matching.

integrations.name: ODM node allocations
integrations.description: HDM uses EAM allocations to determine the ODM node associated with a hierarchy node, including inheritance from ancestors.
integrations.notes: Direct and inherited allocations are distinguished.

integrations.name: Organisational node reference
integrations.description: HDM relates hierarchy nodes to organisational context represented by ODM nodes.
integrations.notes: Functional relationship; no claim about underlying data transport.

integrations.name: People insight
integrations.description: Planned hub presentation of people and identity-related outputs.

integrations.name: Governed entity insight
integrations.description: Planned hub presentation of entities and their associations.

integrations.name: Hierarchy insight
integrations.description: Planned hub presentation of structural information.

integrations.name: Performance insight
integrations.description: Planned hub presentation of KPI and geographic outputs.
